# Extract the numeric part from the 'home team score' column
# The scores are in format like "14.7 (91)", we need the number before the parentheses
df['home_score_numeric'] = df['home team score'].str.extract(r'(\d+\.\d+)').astype(float)

# Calculate the average of the extracted numeric scores
average_home_score = df['home_score_numeric'].mean()

# Check if the average is equal to 15.67 (within a small tolerance for floating point comparison)
answer = abs(average_home_score - 15.67) < 0.01
